runtime.limitation: Fixed local process and unsigned hashes; host/runtime remain trusted. No immutable storage, external administration or independent source build is established.

protocol.design: Twelve new authored tasks (4 development, 8 prospective held-out), two persistent notices, two guarded interfaces. Every inference is new and counted separately. No tuning between splits. Intent interface restricts model responsibility to a numeric answer; host compiles protocol and selects trusted target. Not model learning, a blind external benchmark, an estimate of prompt-injection prevalence or a proof of correct scientific answers.
